author: MLGtino
body:
Lock/archive posts others make regarding staff applications. Whether it be an entire thread related to "What are my chances of getting mod", or a single post saying "Im under review, but idk if ill make it :/". If it does you one better, just make it hurt their chances of becoming moderator. 

Also all of the posts asking questions about it, just send them a link to Nolan/Jozz's post, then lock it.

If I see another one of these on the forums, Im changing my password and throwing away the key.
